title: Neo Performance Materials
summary: Canadian rare-earth processor supplying magnets and specialty materials.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Neo Performance Materials processes rare earths and produces magnets, rare-earth chemicals and specialty ceramics from facilities in Europe and Asia. It is one of the few non-Chinese magnet producers with established customers in automotive and industrial motors. The company is expanding magnet capacity in Estonia.

Technology Exposure

  • Sintered rare-earth magnets
  • Rare-earth chemicals and oxides
  • Specialty ceramics

What To Watch

  • Estonia magnet plant ramp
  • Automotive and defence demand
  • Feedstock supply

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
